Draft a project plan in canvas. I've put together a project plan in the canvas.
Phase 1 covers requirements gathering and stakeholder interviews across two weeks, followed by Phase 2's technical design and architecture review. Phase 3 is the main implementation window, budgeted at six weeks with a mid-point checkpoint demo. Phase 4 wraps up with integration testing, security review, and a staged rollout to a small percentage of users before full launch. Each phase has a named owner and a Slack channel for daily standups, with weekly written status updates sent to stakeholders every Friday afternoon.
